claims.text: Compact, AI-assisted robotic package-sorting systems for the warehouses and fulfilment centres of e-commerce and logistics companies. Pune-based, founded 2019.
Risks recorded by the fund: Long enterprise sales cycles, pilot-to-rollout conversion uncertain, hardware margin structure unproven at scale, and several better-funded global competitors.

Partner assessment of founders from the meeting: Pramod Ghadge (CEO) and Shahid Memon (CTO). A clean split: one builds the company, the other builds the machine. What impressed us in the meeting was how little they relied on the deck; both talked about specific customer sites and what broke during pilots. They described failures before we asked. Concern: the CEO was still learning to sell to large enterprise procurement teams, and hardware hiring in Pune was not yet proven.
